approval_required_for: Any architecture or pipeline repair that changes lanes, datapath width, tile sizes, stage topology, stream order, residual or branch paths, template selection, or Stage 3 FIFO authority.

Any change to numeric policy, rounding semantics, saturation behavior, activation/weight/accumulator dtype, input_bits, output_bits, internal element bits, residual precision, explicit cast points, golden-reference policy, or tolerance.

Any concrete memory address assignment, base-address map, non-overlap policy, address-alignment policy, DDR channel assumption, memory-layout change, or runtime ABI field before runtime or board consumption.
Any major template rewrite or free-form RTL repair outside approved template binding, bounded glue-code, or repair_boundary_check limits.

SACG memory reports no active_contamination_barriers, no open_backtrack_requests, and no open_retry_requests; therefore there is no pre-existing memory blocker to honor before same-stage recovery.

The LLM call encountered repeated transient 504 Gateway Time-out errors and a 429 concurrency limit before producing dse_parameter_agent output; LLM execution is mandatory, so fallback or stale records cannot be treated as successful agent decisions.

The stage command then failed because the dse_parameter_agent status was not accepted and the agent reported 7 current-stage unresolved risks. These are current-stage blockers under the supplied stage result, even though the visible status string included ready_static_gate_no_current_blockers.

No retry_reconciliation_contract was supplied; the next retry must explicitly distinguish failed/non-promoted diagnostics from any candidate retry artifacts and may supersede them only after all current-stage checks pass.

No stage_gate_policy was supplied, so classification is based on flow_policy and the failed stage summary: downstream code_generation is blocked; bounded same-stage retry is allowed because attempt_count 1 is below the configured limit of 2.
proposed_actions: Record a stage artifact trust barrier marking stale and failed parameter_binding outputs as diagnostic-only, not valid downstream inputs.
Localize the reported parameter_binding static-gate failure from the command log and non-promoted LLM result to enumerate the 7 current-stage unresolved risks without promoting the failed report.

Retry parameter_binding once using the original pipeline_planning SACG state plus the localized diagnostic context, requiring a retry reconciliation contract and all current-stage static checks to pass.

If the bounded retry passes, promote only the new candidate artifacts and proceed toward code_generation; if it fails, stop downstream progress and create a bounded repair/backtrack decision based on the localized failure class.
risks: Consuming the stale or failed parameter_binding_report.json downstream would contaminate code_generation with an unvalidated parameter contract.

The 7 current-stage unresolved risks are not detailed in the supplied summary; they could hide cross-layer inconsistencies across model configuration, shape binding, numeric policy, template coverage, stream order, memory/runtime planning, or implementation assumptions.
Transient LLM service failures may recur and cause another failed attempt without providing a valid design decision.
If the retry repairs unresolved risks by changing architecture, pipeline topology, memory layout, numeric policy, or major template choices without approval, it would violate the approval boundary.
A second failed attempt would exhaust the bounded per-stage attempt budget and should trigger bounded repair/backtrack triage rather than repeated retries.
